name: gazebo
summary: 3D robotics simulator for testing robot models, sensors, controls, and autonomous system behavior.
why_it_matters: Gazebo remains useful robotics capability knowledge, but the repo does not currently validate any simulator-backed scenario that would justify active support.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs robot simulation before real-world deployment.
Operators need virtual sensor and actuator testing environments.
The workflow benefits from simulation-backed robotics development.

platform_support.notes: Simulator support varies across host OSes, graphics stacks, and ROS integration expectations.

prerequisites: Defined model, world, and artifact storage conventions
implementation_notes: Promotion should define a narrow supported simulator workflow.
Separate pure simulation use from ROS-integrated workflows.
Avoid claiming support until a real robot development scenario needs it.
operational_notes: Graphics stack and driver issues dominate portability.
Simulation workloads often need large assets and sample environments.
Validation should run a known world and verify usable startup.
risks: Robotics simulation stacks are operationally heavy.
Desktop and GPU assumptions make blanket support claims unreliable.
